nodes.name: agent_core_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges CLI agent sessions to the embedded agent-core execution engine, running turns, snapshotting available tools, and relaying plan approval responses.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Tauri command surface for CLI-based agent sessions -- creating, running, messaging, approving, resuming, deleting, merging, and inspecting worktree state for CLI agent sessions.

nodes.name: hook_approvals.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks interactive permission-approval requests raised by CLI agent tool-call hooks, broadcasting them to the frontend and resolving user decisions.

nodes.name: launch_profile_store.rs
nodes.summary: Persists and resolves per-agent CLI launch profiles (permission mode, command/args/env overrides) to a JSON file on disk.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for CLI agent session support: initializes/migrates the SQLite schema for CLI agent sessions and re-exports the agent_core_bridge, commands, hook_approvals, launch_profile_store, native_transcript, parsers, persistence, platform_adapters, session_runner, skill_sync, tui_bridge, and types submodules.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs an agent-core turn for a session using the given request parameters, driving execution through the embedded agent-core engine.

nodes.name: tools_snapshot
nodes.summary: Returns a snapshot of the tools currently registered/available to the agent-core engine for the given session.

nodes.name: respond_plan_approval
nodes.summary: Forwards a plan approval/rejection decision from the UI into the agent-core engine for the session.

nodes.name: cli_registered_tool_names
nodes.summary: Lists tool names registered with the CLI agent bridge for exposure to the agent-core engine.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the agent-core bridge's Tauri commands/handlers with the application.

nodes.name: cli_launch_profile_get
nodes.summary: Tauri command that retrieves the stored launch profile for a CLI agent by delegating to the launch profile store.

nodes.name: cli_launch_profile_update
nodes.summary: Tauri command that updates permission mode, command, args, or env overrides for a CLI agent's launch profile.

nodes.name: cli_launch_profile_reset
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resets a CLI agent's launch profile to defaults.

nodes.name: inject_ide_context_into_prompt
nodes.summary: Merges IDE context (open files, selections, etc.) into the user's prompt text before sending it to a CLI agent.

nodes.name: cli_agent_create
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates a new CLI agent session, provisioning session state and persistence records.

nodes.name: cli_agent_tui_release
nodes.summary: Tauri command that releases a TUI-bound CLI agent session so it can be reattached or torn down.

nodes.name: cli_agent_run
nodes.summary: Tauri command that starts or resumes a CLI agent run for a session with the given prompt and options.

nodes.name: cli_agent_message
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sends a follow-up message to a running or new CLI agent session.

nodes.name: cli_agent_approval_response
nodes.summary: Tauri command that submits the user's approve/deny decision for a pending CLI agent tool-call approval.

nodes.name: cli_agent_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current status of a CLI agent session.

nodes.name: cli_agent_history_mutation
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current history-mutation epoch for a CLI agent session.

nodes.name: cli_agent_cancel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that cancels a running CLI agent session.

nodes.name: cli_agent_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists all CLI agent sessions.

nodes.name: load_native_transcript_chunks
nodes.summary: Loads transcript chunks for a session from its native (imported) transcript source rather than the managed chunk store.

nodes.name: cli_agent_transcript_path
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resolves the on-disk transcript location (native or managed) for a CLI agent session.

nodes.name: synthesized_user_message_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a synthesized user-message chunk representing the session's initial prompt for display.

nodes.name: cli_agent_chunks
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the transcript chunks for a CLI agent session, from native or managed storage.

nodes.name: cli_agent_truncate_after_chunk
nodes.summary: Tauri command that truncates a session's transcript after a given point, optionally reverting file changes.

nodes.name: cli_agent_resume
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resumes a previously paused/stopped CLI agent session.

nodes.name: cli_agent_delete
nodes.summary: Tauri command that deletes a CLI agent session and its associated state.

nodes.name: cli_agent_merge
nodes.summary: Tauri command that merges a CLI agent session's worktree changes back into the base branch using the given strategy.

nodes.name: cli_agent_worktree_diff
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the diff between a CLI agent session's worktree and its base branch.

nodes.name: cli_agent_worktree_discard
nodes.summary: Tauri command that discards uncommitted changes in a CLI agent session's worktree.

nodes.name: as_wire_str
nodes.summary: Converts a HookApprovalDecision variant to its wire-protocol string representation.

nodes.name: register_session_permission_mode
nodes.summary: Registers the active permission mode for a CLI agent session so hook approvals can be resolved automatically when appropriate.

nodes.name: unregister_session
nodes.summary: Removes a session's registered permission mode and pending-approval state on session teardown.

nodes.name: session_permission_mode
nodes.summary: Looks up the currently registered permission mode for a session.

nodes.name: session_wants_interactive_approval
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session's permission mode requires interactive user approval for tool calls.

nodes.name: broadcast_permission_request
nodes.summary: Emits a permission-request event to the frontend for a pending tool-call approval.

nodes.name: park_hook_approval
nodes.summary: Registers a pending hook approval and blocks/waits (with timeout) for the user's decision.

nodes.name: resolve_hook_approval
nodes.summary: Resolves a pending hook approval with the user's decision, unblocking the waiting hook.

nodes.name: has_pending_hook_approval
nodes.summary: Checks whether a specific hook approval request is still pending.

nodes.name: store_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the filesystem path of the launch profile store JSON file.

nodes.name: read_store
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes the launch profile store from disk.

nodes.name: write_store
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the launch profile store back to disk.

nodes.name: parse_cli_agent
nodes.summary: Parses a CLI agent name string into its corresponding CliAgentType.

nodes.name: normalize_optional_string
nodes.summary: Normalizes an optional override string, treating blank values as unset.

nodes.name: normalize_optional_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes an optional list of CLI argument overrides.

nodes.name: normalize_optional_env
nodes.summary: Normalizes an optional map of environment variable overrides.

nodes.name: normalize_permission_mode
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a requested permission mode against an agent's supported defaults.

nodes.name: resolve_cli_launch_profile
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective launch profile (defaults merged with stored overrides) for a CLI agent type.

nodes.name: cli_launch_profile_get
nodes.summary: Retrieves the effective launch profile for a named CLI agent.

nodes.name: cli_launch_profile_update
nodes.summary: Applies an update to a CLI agent's launch profile overrides and persists the store.

nodes.name: cli_launch_profile_reset
nodes.summary: Clears a CLI agent's launch profile overrides, reverting it to defaults.

nodes.name: init_cli_agent_tables
nodes.summary: Creates and migrates the SQLite tables/columns backing CLI agent sessions and their transcript chunks, applying incremental ALTER TABLE migrations.

nodes.name: migrate_strip_ide_context
nodes.summary: One-time data migration that strips embedded <ide_context> markup from stored user inputs and chunk results.

nodes.name: HookApprovalDecision
nodes.summary: Enum representing the outcome of a hook permission decision: Allow, Deny, or Passthrough.
